title: Features
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
Features

When this operation is executed, the Contract Accounts that are related to the provided Business Partner Internal ID are retrieved.
A Business Partner Internal ID is mandatory; if you do not provide one, you will receive an error message and no results will be
returned.

Error Handling
If you do not enter a Business Partner Internal ID , you will receive an error.

No Contract Account will be found if you enter an invalid Business Partner Internal ID. Note : Users should have the proper
authorization in order to display Contract Accounts.

Message Types

e ContractAccountERPByBusinessPartnerQuery_sync

e ContractAccountERPByBusinessPartnerResponse_sync

Prerequisites

To use this service operation, the FI-CA application component should be implemented.

Notes on SAP Implementation

Switch Framework: Any business function set that includes an activated FICA switch via related business functions can use this
service.

Configuration:

The operation is suitable for the following sectors in particular: Contract A/R and A/P, Industry Extension Public Sector, Insurance,
SAP Media, Telco and Utilities. However, it is necessary that the customer runs the FI-CA application component in order to use it.
Note : Users must have the proper authorization in order to display a Contract Account (authorization object F_KKVK_BEG).

Enhancements:

Events are defined for additional function modules that can be called as customer exits for defining specific inbound/outbound
application mapping logic.

e For inbound mapping:

o Event 4604

o FICA Services: Inbound XI Mapping ContractAccountByBPld

o Sample module: FKK_SAMPLE_4604 in function group FKK_XI_LEVENTS
e For outbound mapping:

o Event 4605
